title: Guided circuit-breaker & fallback variant composer for Console
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Background: Customers need an approachable way to author routing policies that combine region selection, tier-based routing, and deterministic fallback model variants while protecting production SLAs. Current Console policy authoring is powerful but assumes the user understands low-level rule ordering and failure modes. This ticket designs and ships a guided 'Composer' flow that surfaces circuit-breaker heuristics, shows end-to-end fallthrough for variant fallbacks, and estimates cost/latency impact before committing.

Scope:
- Create a multi-step Console flow (Compose -> Validate -> Preview -> Rollout) focused on: region priority sets, tier weighting, and fallback variant ordering + circuit-breaker thresholds.
- Embedded lightweight validator that flags unsafe rules (e.g., broad region wildcard with low-redundancy + expensive model fallback).
- Real-time "what-if" simulator that shows per-region latency and cost delta for a representative traffic sample (using anonymized telemetry baseline).
- Visualized fallback path trace for a sample request: which variant/model will be selected at each step and why (capacity, tier, region, circuit-breaker).
- Canary rollout helper that creates a gradual percentage-based promotion with automatic automatic fallback to previous policy on error spike.
- Export/import template support for common industry patterns (e.g., EU-primary then US-fallback; low-cost-tier-first; high-reliability-fallback).

Out of scope: deep performant traffic replayer for full-scale simulations (handled by separate simulator ticket). Full RBAC controls for templates (handled by IAM epic).

Goals:
1) Reduce customer errors caused by misordered fallback rules by 80% in targeted cohorts.
2) Reduce time-to-author policy for new customers from hours to minutes with templates and guided checks.
3) Surface clear estimated cost delta for policy changes before apply.

User stories: 
- As an SRE, I want the composer to warn me when a fallback model is CPU-heavy so I can pick a quantized variant.
- As a PM, I want a preview that shows how 5 sample requests would traverse the policy to validate correctness.
- As a platform engineer, I want the canary helper to automatically create a rollback step if failures exceed thresholds.

Design constraints & tradeoffs:
- Validator uses heuristic and sampled telemetry, not perfect ground-truth. We will clearly label estimates as approximations.
- Preview must be fast; we will restrict sample size to representative traces and allow a deeper simulation as an optional step.
- Circuit-breaker defaults should be conservative; advanced users can tune thresholds in advanced mode.

Acceptance criteria: see acceptance_criteria field.

Success metrics:
- 80% reduction in policy misconfiguration incidents for customers using Composer within 12 weeks of release.
- >50% of new routing policies created via Composer (vs raw JSON edits) in first quarter after launch.
acceptance_criteria: Composer flow implemented in Console with Compose -> Validate -> Preview -> Rollout steps
Validator returns categoryed warnings (safety, cost, reliability) and blocks only P0-level risks when 'enforce' is enabled
Preview visual shows fallback path traces for at least five representative sample requests
What-if cost/latency estimates displayed with delta vs current policy
Canary rollout generator creates progressive percentage steps and a configurable automatic rollback threshold
Exportable JSON/template feature for saved policy blueprints
